description: Saved reduced human EGFR-MAPK materialization case; generic receptor art does not verify molecular structure.

assumptions: Selected human signaling events only; this is not the complete Reactome pathway.
EGFR denotes ligand-activated receptor; binding, dimerization and autophosphorylation are collapsed into a summary step.
RAS and RAF are family-level summaries; MEK1/2 and ERK1/2 denote the stated family members, not single proteins.
Recruitment and activation summary arrows can omit intermediates, including SHC1 and RAF regulatory steps.
Panels group explanatory stages, not cellular compartments. Feedback, crosstalk, nuclear transport and phenotypic outcomes are outside this diagram.
document.message: Reduced human EGFR-MAPK signaling. Panels show explanatory stages, not physical compartments. Show the supplied scope caption below the diagram.
document.relationship_note: Only the six supplied directed relationships; summary edges do not assert single-step direct molecular interactions. No inhibitory relationships are specified.
